# Do Phylogenetic analysis

```{r}
extract_pp1_tree <- function(file_path) {
  library(ape)
  library(stringr)

  # Step 1: Read file
  tree_raw <- readLines(file_path)
  tree_text <- paste(tree_raw, collapse = "")
  tree_string <- sub("^.*tree [^=]+ = \\[&R\\] ", "", tree_text)

  cat("=== Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 2: Extract [&label="..."]: blocks
  label_pattern <- "\\[&label=\"(.*?)\"\\]:"
  label_matches <- str_match_all(tree_string, label_pattern)[[1]]
  cat("=== Raw Label Match Count ===\n")
  cat(nrow(label_matches), "metadata blocks matched\n\n")

  if (nrow(label_matches) == 0) stop("No valid metadata blocks found.")

  cat("=== First Metadata Block ===\n")
  cat(label_matches[1, 1], "\n\n")

  # Step 3: Extract pp1
  label_blocks <- label_matches[, 2]
  pp1_values <- sapply(label_blocks, function(x) {
    str_match(x, "pp1=([0-9\\.]+)")[, 2]
  }) |> as.numeric()
  cat("Extracted", length(pp1_values), "pp1 values\n\n")

  # Step 4: Clean tree string
  clean_tree_string <- str_replace_all(tree_string, label_pattern, ":")
  cat("=== Cleaned Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(clean_tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 5: Read tree
  tree <- tryCatch(
    {
      read.tree(text = clean_tree_string)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Error reading tree:\n", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (inherits(tree, "multiPhylo")) {
    cat("Tree is multiPhylo — using the first tree.\n")
    tree <- tree[[1]]
  }

  if (!inherits(tree, "phylo")) stop("Failed to parse tree properly.")

  # Step 6: Check internal nodes
  num_internal <- tree$Nnode
  cat("Tree has", num_internal, "internal nodes\n")

  # Step 7: Assign pp1 values
  if (length(pp1_values) < num_internal) {
    warning("Fewer pp1 values than internal nodes. Padding with NA.")
    pp1_values <- c(pp1_values, rep(NA, num_internal - length(pp1_values)))
  } else if (length(pp1_values) > num_internal) {
    warning("More pp1 values than internal nodes. Trimming.")
    pp1_values <- pp1_values[1:num_internal]
  }

  tree$node.label <- as.character(pp1_values)
  return(tree)
}
```

```{r}
tree <- extract_pp1_tree("Results/Phylogeny/species_tree_output.tree")
```

```{r}
# --- Root tree ---
tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "Zhuliangomyces_illinitus", resolve.root = TRUE)

# --- Fortify and add support ---
tree_data <- ggtree::fortify(tree)
tree_data$support <- NA
internal_nodes <- which(tree_data$isTip == FALSE)
tree_data$support[internal_nodes] <- as.numeric(tree$node.label)

# --- Base plot ---
p <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.6) %<+% tree_data +
  geom_tree(aes(color = support)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#000000", mid = "#ff0000", high = "green",
    midpoint = 0.40, na.value = "black"
  ) +

  # Tip labels with space (no clipping)
  geom_tiplab(
    size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
    align = TRUE, linesize = 0.3, offset = 0.03
  ) +

  # Internal support values
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip & !is.na(support) & support > 0.6,
      label = round(support, 2)
    ),
    hjust = -0.4, size = 2.5, color = "#317000"
  ) +

  # Layout fixes
  theme_minimal() +
  expand_limits(x = 1.1) + # force extra space on the right
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10) # top, right, bottom, left
  ) +
  labs(color = "ASTRAL pp1 Support")

# --- Save (no clipping) ---
ggsave("Amanita_tree_highlighted.png",
  plot = p, width = 12, height = 12,
  units = "in", dpi = 600, limitsize = FALSE
)
```

# Prep combination of Morphometic and Phylogenetic data

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Clean species names for matching
# -------------------------------

tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_trim() %>%
  stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
  gsub("'|\"", "", .)  # Remove quotes if present

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Merge all data
# -------------------------------
df_full <- pca %>%
  left_join(vol, by = "species") %>%
  #left_join(eco, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(clim, by = "species")

# Set rownames early for convenience
df_full <- df_full %>%
  column_to_rownames("species")

```

```{r}
# Function to prepare dataset and prune tree per model
prepare_model_data <- function(tree, df, vars) {
  df_model <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    drop_na()

  species <- rownames(df_model)
  tree_model <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species))
  tree_model$edge.length[tree_model$edge.length == 0] <- 1e-8
  tree_model$node.label <- NULL

  # Reorder and add species column
  df_model <- df_model[match(tree_model$tip.label, rownames(df_model)), ]
  stopifnot(rownames(df_model) == tree_model$tip.label)
  df_model$species <- rownames(df_model)

  # Return comparative data object
  comparative.data(tree_model, df_model, names.col = "species", vcv = TRUE)
}

```

```{r}

# PC1 ~ Precipitation
comp_shape1 <- prepare_model_data(tree, df_full, c("PC1_mean", "Precipitation_monthly"))
mod_shape1 <- pgls(PC1_mean ~ Precipitation_monthly, data = comp_shape1, lambda = "ML")

# PC1 ~ Climate
comp_shape2 <- prepare_model_data(tree, df_full, c("PC1_mean", "climate_group"))
mod_shape2 <- pgls(PC1_mean ~ climate_group, data = comp_shape2, lambda = "ML")

# PC1 ~ Precip + Climate
comp_shape3 <- prepare_model_data(tree, df_full, c("PC1_mean", "Precipitation_monthly", "climate_group"))
mod_shape3 <- pgls(PC1_mean ~ Precipitation_monthly + climate_group, data = comp_shape3, lambda = "ML")

```

```{r}
# Volume ~ Precipitation
comp_vol1 <- prepare_model_data(tree, df_full, c("avg_volume_estimated", "Precipitation_monthly"))
mod_vol1 <- pgls(avg_volume_estimated ~ Precipitation_monthly, data = comp_vol1, lambda = "ML")

# Volume ~ Climate
comp_vol2 <- prepare_model_data(tree, df_full, c("avg_volume_estimated", "climate_group"))
mod_vol2 <- pgls(avg_volume_estimated ~ climate_group, data = comp_vol2, lambda = "ML")

# Volume ~ Precip + Climate
comp_vol3 <- prepare_model_data(tree, df_full, c("avg_volume_estimated", "Precipitation_monthly", "climate_group"))
mod_vol3 <- pgls(avg_volume_estimated ~ Precipitation_monthly + climate_group, data = comp_vol3, lambda = "ML")


```

```{r}

# Compare models with AICc
model_set_shape <- model.sel(mod_shape1, mod_shape2, mod_shape3)
model_set_vol <- model.sel(mod_vol1, mod_vol2, mod_vol3)

```

```{r}
# Capture summary and lambda
print(model_set_shape)
# Record sample sizes per model for reporting
sample_sizes <- c(
  mod1 = nrow(comp_shape1$data),
  mod2 = nrow(comp_shape2$data),
  mod3 = nrow(comp_shape3$data)
)
print(sample_sizes)
# Get top model(s): delta AICc < 2 are equally supported
# You can select the best model manually or:
best_model <- get.models(model_set_shape, subset = delta < 2)[[1]]
# ---------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Summarize the Top Model
# ---------------------------------------------
summary(best_model)       # View coefficients, p-values, λ
best_model$param["lambda" ]  # Extract estimated Pagel's λ

```
